svg.title: Spending limits per category — SoftTrack web design mockup (#295)
svg.desc: Every claim is decided on its merits by a finance admin who holds the policy in their head, and the claimant finds out what the policy is when a claim is refused. A category can carry a limit per claim or per person per month and an amount above which a receipt is needed; the form says so while the claim is typed; and a claim over the limit is submitted with a reason and marked.
svg.text: · the policy, read before the money is spent
The policy, where it can be read before spending

g.text: Finance → Categories, signed in as Omar
What a claim is for, and what is usual for it. Limits are readable by everyone, beside the category they belong to.
Limits are per currency, since amounts are never converted.
